expc.loadError: The expense claim could not be loaded.
expc.error.generic: The request could not be completed.
expc.error.network: The server could not be reached. Try again.
expc.denied.body: Ask your administrator for access to expense claims.
expc.gone.body: It may not exist, or it may not be yours to see.
expc.noEmployment.body: An expense claim is made for a current employment. Ask HR if you think this is wrong.
expc.list.description: Your expense claims, and those of the people you are allowed to see. Open a claim to read it, or start a new one.
expc.new.title: New expense claim
expc.new.description: Add a line for each expense, attach the receipts, then submit the claim for approval.
expc.claim.title: Expense claim {no}
expc.claim.description: The lines, their policy checks, the receipts and where the claim stands.
expc.via.payroll.help: The approved amount is added to your next pay.
expc.via.payment_batch.help: The approved amount is paid on its own, outside payroll.
expc.flag.blocks: This category does not allow it: correct the line before you submit.
expc.hidden.title: You may not see this amount
expc.hidden.note: Amounts are hidden from you on this claim.
expc.onBehalf: (you are making this claim for them)
expc.field.title: Title
expc.field.title.help: Optional: what the claim is for, for example a trip or a month.
expc.field.currency: The claim is paid in {currency}. A line in another currency is converted at the company's rate when you save.
expc.returned.title: This claim was returned to you
expc.returned.body: The approver asked for a correction. Change the lines, then submit it again.
expc.blocked.title: Some lines break a rule of their category
expc.blocked.body: {count, plural, one {# line cannot be submitted as it is.} other {# lines cannot be submitted as they are.}} Correct them or remove them, then submit again.
expc.submitFailed: The claim was saved but not submitted
expc.fix: Some lines are not complete. Fix the marked fields.
expc.line.remove.label: Remove this line
expc.line.currency.converted: Converted to {currency} at the company's rate when you save.
expc.line.receipt.required: This category asks for a receipt.
expc.err.date: Give the date of the expense.
expc.err.amount: Type an amount with digits and at most four decimals, for example 1250.50.
expc.err.amount.positive: The amount must be more than zero.
expc.err.currency: Give the currency as three capital letters, for example USD.
expc.err.quantity: Type a number more than zero.
expc.err.quantity.required: Give the number of days or kilometres for this category.
expc.submitted: The claim was sent for approval.
expc.submitted.flagged: The claim was sent for approval. {count, plural, one {# line carries a policy flag.} other {# lines carry policy flags.}}
expc.cancel.title: Cancel this draft?
expc.cancel.body: The draft ends and keeps its number. You cannot reopen it; make a new claim if you still need one.
expc.waiting: The claim is waiting for its approver.
expc.waiting.finance: The claim is waiting for approval, and finance decides after the manager.
expc.receipts.saveFirst: Save the draft first, then add receipts to it.
expc.receipts.help: Pictures (PNG, JPEG) or PDF files. Then choose the receipt on each line.
expc.receipts.failed: These files could not be added: {names}
expc.receipts.downloadError: The file could not be downloaded.
expc.receipts.listError: The receipts could not be listed.
expc.categories.error: The expense categories could not be loaded.
expc.categories.empty.body: HR has to add the categories of expense first. Ask HR.
expc.card.title: Expense claim
expc.card.flagged.body: Some lines are over the limit, use a receipt twice, miss a receipt or fall outside the claim period. Check them before you approve.
expc.decide.err.amount: Type an amount with digits and at most four decimals.
expc.decide.err.above: The approved amount cannot be more than was claimed.
expc.decide.err.reason: Give a reason when you approve less than was claimed.
expc.decide.note: Save the line decisions first. The Approve button of this task then approves the saved amounts; a line you do not change is approved as claimed.
expc.finance.title: Expense payments
expc.finance.description: Approved claims that wait for payment, and paid claims, with the payment status the payment returned.
expc.categories.description: The kinds of expense people can claim. The limits by grade and the per-diem and mileage rates are in the expense policy (HR policies).
expc.categories.help.code: The code the expense policy refers to.
expc.categories.help.kind: General: an amount. Per diem: a rate per day. Mileage: a rate per kilometre.
expc.categories.help.tax: A label for payroll (for example taxable or not); the rules come from the country pack.
expc.categories.help.component: The payroll component a claim of this category is paid through.
expc.categories.delete.body: {category} is removed from the choices. Claims that used it keep it.
expc.rates.description: The company's exchange rates for claims in another currency. A line is converted at the latest rate on or before the date of the expense.
expc.rates.help.from: The currency of the expense, three capital letters.
expc.rates.help.to: The currency the claim is paid in.
expc.rates.help.rate: How many units of the second currency one unit of the first is worth.
